# SitTall - Fix Your Posture

> SitTall - Fix Your Posture is a macOS menu bar app that uses AirPods motion sensors to detect slouching and send gentle posture reminders. No camera. No account. No data collection.

## Key Facts
- Platform: Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 14 Sonoma or later
- Confirmed earbuds: AirPods 3rd generation, AirPods 4, AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation, AirPods Pro all models, AirPods Max, Beats Fit Pro
- Price: Paid (see Mac App Store for current pricing)
- Privacy: All motion analysis runs locally on-device. Zero data collection, no network requests, no cloud component.
- Detection: Uses 6-axis accelerometer and gyroscope data from compatible AirPods or Beats earbuds to track forward head drift, side tilt, and gradual posture collapse.
- Roadmap: More languages, looking-down mode, saved calibration profiles, more reminder interval options, menu bar icon fixes and variants, custom notification sounds, and an iOS app.
